clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar’s Valley of Honor, Ogunaro Wolfrunner tends the Horde’s foremost wolf kennel beside the Hunter’s Hall. He breeds and trains fierce wolves for orc champions and their trusted allies.

Ogunaro Wolfrunner tends Orgrimmar’s battle wolves beside the Hunter’s Hall in the Valley of Honor. Orcs and wolves have shared a bond for generations, across Draenor’s plains and Durotar’s wilderness. It rests on mutual respect, not simple domestication. Ogunaro entrusts only the hardiest beasts, from dire wolves to agile timber prowlers, to warriors who have proven their strength and worth to the warchief.
